value.body: Tax analysts prepare tax computations and returns and check compliance with income-tax and GST rules for a company or its clients. They work in CA firms, consulting firms, corporate finance teams and shared-service centres, and the day involves reconciling data, preparing returns, and responding to queries and notices.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: B.Com, BBA; often CA, CMA or an M.Com

items.label: Common tools
items.value: Excel, Tally or an ERP, Income Tax and GST portals

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Freshers often start in CA firms as article assistants (if pursuing CA) or as tax associates in consulting and shared-service firms. A course in GST or income-tax practice and comfort with the government portals help.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Reconciliation of books with tax data

value.title: At a glance
items: Work peaks around return due dates and year-end.
Common next steps: senior tax analyst, tax manager, or a move into advisory.
Tax law changes every Budget, so regular updating is needed.
